citeinfo.title: Montana 2005-2013 Legislative Districts
citeinfo.othercit: The former name of the data set on the NRIS web site was "leg2004"

descript.abstract: Montana Legislative Districts for the 2005 through 2013 Legislatures. Each polygon represents a House District. Senate Districts are each composed of two House Districts, whose district numbers equal twice the Senate District number and twice the Senate District number, minus one

horizpa.horizpar: The district boundary coordinates are from U.S. Census Bureau 2000 Redistricting TIGER/Line files. These files are mostly based on 1:100,000 scale data, which have a positional accuracy of approximately 50 meters, or 160 feet.

srcinfo.srccontr: The coordinates of the district boundaries are from this source.
This is the source of the population data that the Montana Redistricting and Apportionment Commission used to create districts of approximately equal population.

procstep.procdesc: Convert TIGER data to ESRI shapefile data showing census geography, using AutoBound version 4 software (Digital Engineering Corporation, Annapolis MD, 410-295-3333).
Define legislative districts and save them as an ESRI shapefile.
